text: Michael Garrett becomes Chair of the IAA SETI Committee at IAC 2021 in Dubai. The new Executive, including Andrew Siemion, Carol Oliver and Lori Walton, makes revising the protocols a priority, and serious work on the update begins.
The Committee makes updating the 2010 Declaration a high priority and forms a Post-Detection Task Group, chaired by Michael Garrett, with Kathryn Denning, Les Tennen and Carol Oliver.
First public report on the revision at IAC 2023 in Baku.
First full draft, a comparison with the 2010 text, and a consultation plan are presented in Milan.
Consultation with Committee members and then the wider SETI community.
The September 2025 draft and the consultation results are presented in Sydney.
Committee vote on the 27 November 2025 version: 53 for, 1 against, 3 abstentions.
The IAA Board of Trustees adopts the 2026 Update as an IAA Position Paper.
The IAA publishes the Declaration (dated 1 June 2026) and announces it in a press release.
The Committee meets at IAC 2026 in Antalya, Türkiye, to plan the next steps, including a Post-Detection Sub-Committee.
